verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe several in-product AI features that produce insights and suggestions from incident data. Suggestions drafts updates, summaries and follow-up actions from incident activity. Suggested summaries condense incident information for responders. Postmortem AI writes first drafts and gives inline review suggestions. Investigations gather evidence from alerts, past incidents, code and telemetry, then form and test root-cause hypotheses. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of these AI features (all evidence is vendor docs).
